resources.string: Report sends a cleaned log to the Delos report service (kept 30 days, readable by anyone who has the link) and opens a GitHub draft for you to check. Nothing is sent before you choose.
Report uploads a cleaned log (kept 30 days) and opens a GitHub draft to check.
Save the log to Downloads instead
Log uploaded; its link is in the draft. It is kept for 30 days.
The log was not uploaded (%1$s). Saved to Downloads as %2$s. Attach it to the issue.
The log was not uploaded (%1$s) and could not be saved. Share it from Settings → About → Debug info.
the report service is busy, try again later
the report service did not accept it
Saves the same cleaned log to Downloads and opens the GitHub draft for you to attach it. Nothing is uploaded.
